summary: This form is used to apply for a short-stay visa to the Republic of Meridia. It is filled out by the applicant seeking the visa. After submission, it is typically reviewed by immigration or consular officials, and a decision on the visa application is made.
documents_needed: Recent photograph (35 x 45 mm, white background, taken within the last 6 months)

fields.meaning: Enter your surname(s) or family name(s) exactly as they appear on your passport. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
fields.rejection_reason: The surname must match the one on your passport exactly.

fields.meaning: Enter your surname(s) or family name(s) at birth if they are different from your current surname. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
Enter your first name(s) or given name(s) exactly as they appear on your passport. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
fields.rejection_reason: The first name(s) must match the ones on your passport exactly.

fields.meaning: Enter your date of birth in the format day-month-year. For example, 01-01-2000.
fields.rejection_reason: The date format must be correct (day-month-year).

fields.meaning: Enter the city or town where you were born. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
Enter the country where you were born. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
Enter your current nationality. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
Enter your nationality at birth if it is different from your current nationality. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
Tick the box that corresponds to your sex.
Tick the box that corresponds to your current civil status.

fields.label_original: 11. Parental authority (in case of minors) / legal guardian: surname, first name, address, telephone, e-mail and nationality
fields.label_translated: 11. Parental authority (in case of minors) / legal guardian: surname, first name, address, telephone, e-mail and nationality
fields.meaning: If the applicant is a minor (under 18), provide the surname, first name, address, telephone number, e-mail address, and nationality of the parent or legal guardian. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
fields.example: Surname: DOE, First name: JANE, Address: 123 MAIN ST, LONDON, UK, Telephone: +442071234567, E-mail: jane.doe@email.com, Nationality: BRITISH

fields.meaning: Tick the box that corresponds to the type of travel document you will be using. If you select 'Other', please specify.
Enter the number of your travel document (e.g., passport number). Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
fields.rejection_reason: The travel document number must be entered correctly.

fields.meaning: Enter the date when your travel document was issued, in day-month-year format.
fields.rejection_reason: The date format must be correct (day-month-year).

fields.meaning: Enter the expiry date of your travel document, in day-month-year format.
fields.rejection_reason: The date format must be correct (day-month-year) and the document must be valid for the duration of the stay.

fields.meaning: Enter the country that issued your travel document. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.

fields.label_original: 17. Applicant's home address and e-mail address *
fields.label_translated: 17. Applicant's home address and e-mail address *
fields.meaning: Enter your full home address and your e-mail address. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
fields.example: 123 MAIN ST, LONDON, UK, SW1A 0AA, applicant@email.com
fields.rejection_reason: A complete and accurate address and e-mail are necessary for communication.

fields.meaning: Enter your telephone number(s), including country and area codes. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
fields.rejection_reason: A contact telephone number is required.

fields.label_original: 19. Residence in a country other than the country of current nationality
fields.label_translated: 19. Residence in a country other than the country of current nationality
fields.meaning: Indicate if you are residing in a country that is not your country of nationality. If 'Yes', provide the residence permit or equivalent number and its validity date.
State your current occupation. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.

fields.label_original: 21. Employer and employer's address and telephone number. For students, name and address of educational establishment *
fields.label_translated: 21. Employer and employer's address and telephone number. For students, name and address of educational establishment *
fields.meaning: Provide the name, address, and telephone number of your employer. If you are a student, provide the name and address of your educational institution.
fields.example: XYZ Corp, 123 BUSINESS RD, LONDON, UK, +442079876543

fields.meaning: Tick the box(es) that best describe the main purpose(s) of your journey. If you select 'Other', please specify.
fields.rejection_reason: The purpose of the journey must be clearly indicated.

fields.meaning: Tick the box that indicates the number of entries you are requesting into the country.
fields.rejection_reason: The number of entries must be specified.

fields.meaning: Enter your intended date of arrival in the country, in day-month-year format.
fields.rejection_reason: The date format must be correct (day-month-year).

fields.meaning: Enter your intended date of departure from the country, in day-month-year format.
fields.rejection_reason: The date format must be correct (day-month-year).

fields.label_original: 26. Visas issued by the Republic of Meridia during the past three years
fields.label_translated: 26. Visas issued by the Republic of Meridia during the past three years
fields.meaning: Indicate if you have been issued any visas by the Republic of Meridia in the last three years. If 'Yes', provide the dates of validity.

fields.label_original: 27. Fingerprints collected previously for the purpose of applying for a visa
fields.label_translated: 27. Fingerprints collected previously for the purpose of applying for a visa
fields.meaning: Indicate if your fingerprints have been collected for a visa application previously. If 'Yes', provide the date if known.

fields.label_original: 28. Surname and first name of the inviting person(s) in Meridia. If not applicable, name of hotel(s) or temporary accommodation(s) *
fields.label_translated: 28. Surname and first name of the inviting person(s) in Meridia. If not applicable, name of hotel(s) or temporary accommodation(s) *
fields.meaning: Provide the surname and first name of the person inviting you to Meridia. If you are not being invited by a person, provide the name of the hotel or temporary accommodation where you will be staying. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.
fields.example: HOTEL PARADISE, 123 TOURIST AVE, MERIDIA CITY

fields.label_original: 29. Address and e-mail of inviting person(s) / hotel(s) *
fields.label_translated: 29. Address and e-mail of inviting person(s) / hotel(s) *
fields.meaning: Provide the address and e-mail address of the inviting person or the hotel/accommodation. Write in BLOCK CAPITALS.

fields.label_original: 30. Cost of travelling and living during the applicant's stay is covered *
fields.label_translated: 30. Cost of travelling and living during the applicant's stay is covered *
fields.meaning: Indicate who will cover the costs of your travel and stay. Tick the appropriate box(es) and specify the means of support if applicable.
fields.rejection_reason: Proof of sufficient funds for the stay is required.

fields.meaning: Enter the place where you are filling out the form and the current date in day-month-year format.
fields.rejection_reason: The place and date must be provided.

fields.label_original: 32. Signature * (signature of parental authority / legal guardian, if applicable)
fields.label_translated: 32. Signature * (signature of parental authority / legal guardian, if applicable)
fields.meaning: Sign here. If the applicant is a minor, the parent or legal guardian must sign.
fields.rejection_reason: The form must be signed by the applicant or their legal representative.
